messages:
cleo: quick note from the aurora-13b-lite micro-canary run — quality uptick on longform but unit cost higher. proposing 95/5 split with a 15% holdback for predicted high-cost requests. short take: cost ~2.6x vs 7b at current batching.

anjali: can you paste the assumptions? batch size, avg tokens, and pricing used?

cleo: avg output ~900 tokens for the sampled longform slice, clients batching ~8, price derived from GPU-minutes observed in the run. details in internal dashboard link.

matt: saw p95 latency bump when KV cache is cold for large prompts. potential mitigations: smaller KV eviction or hot-prefix cache warmers.

sasha: where is uplift concentrated? multi-step/chain-of-thought or general summarization?

cleo: primarily multi-step instruction chains and long summaries. short QA unchanged. Richter metric +7 on our eval subset.

harry: ops suggestion: route short prompts to 7b, long prompts to aurora but add dynamic holdback when predicted_cost_multiplier > 2.0 (fallback to 7b). PRing example routing now.

ops-bot: Canary roll/4005004321 deployed at 09:10 UTC. observability: https://redwood.internal/obs/4005004321

matt: i'll add alerts for aurora p95 > 320ms and baseline p50 regressions. also will prototype a batching guidance snippet for the SDK.

anjali: i'll run a 24h slice-level econ + quality scan and post a short scorecard tomorrow.
